parameters.content:
### Workflow Note

**Registration & Confirmation Workflow**

> Receives participant registration details through a webhook, extracts the **name, email, and event**, stores the registration in the **Participants Google Sheet**, sends a **registration confirmation email**, and then triggers the **QR Pass Generation workflow** to generate and deliver the participant’s event QR code.

### Workflow Note

**QR Pass Generation & Email Workflow**

> **Triggered automatically by the Registration & Confirmation Workflow.** Receives the registered participant’s details, generates a **unique QR code**, uploads the QR image to **Google Drive**, downloads the generated file, and sends the **QR Pass to the participant via email** for use at event check-in.

### Workflow Note

**Automated Event Reminder Workflow**

> **Triggered daily at 8:00 AM.** The workflow reads participant information from the **Participants Google Sheet**, checks whether the **event is scheduled for tomorrow**, and, if so, automatically sends a **reminder email** to registered participants. This ensures participants receive timely reminders before the event.

parameters.content:
### Workflow Note

**Automated Certificate Generation & Delivery Workflow**

> **Triggered automatically after the event ends.** The workflow reads the list of **attended participants** from the Google Sheet, generates personalized **PDF certificates**, uploads the certificates to **Google Drive**, downloads the generated files, and **emails the certificates to eligible participants**. This automates the complete post-event certificate distribution process.

### Workflow Note

**Automated Feedback Collection & Analytics Workflow**

> **Triggered when a participant submits the feedback form.** The workflow extracts the submitted feedback, stores it in the **Feedback Google Sheet**, and performs **sentiment analysis using an AI model**. It then retrieves feedback and participant data, combines and compiles the information, and updates the **Analytics Sheet** with consolidated feedback insights. This enables automated **feedback analysis, sentiment tracking, and event performance analytics**.

### Workflow Note

**Automated Feedback Audit & Alert Workflow**

> **Runs automatically every hour.** The workflow reads participant and feedback data from the **Google Sheets**, combines the records, and uses a **JavaScript validation step** to detect issues such as **duplicate email submissions and invalid ratings**. If an issue is detected, it automatically sends an **alert email** and records the audit results in the **AuditLog sheet**. This ensures continuous monitoring of feedback data quality and maintains an auditable record of detected issues.

### Workflow Note

**Attendance Verification & Check-In Workflow**

> Receives attendance scan details through a **webhook**, looks up the participant in the **Participants Google Sheet**, and validates their registration. If the participant is valid, it **marks their attendance in the sheet**; otherwise, it returns an **Invalid Participant response**. This ensures that only registered participants can be checked in to the event.
